version.changelog: Initial release: local agent-to-agent UDP communication with peer discovery, configurable trust model, and conversation limits

llm.summary: The skill's purpose matches a local UDP messenger, but the SKILL.md references runtime tools and a Node runtime without providing implementations or an install path, and it treats a non-secret port value as a primary credential — these inconsistencies warrant caution.

dimensions.detail: Name/description align with local UDP messaging. However, the skill declares 'node' as a required binary and lists several udp_* tools (udp_discover, udp_send, etc.) while being instruction-only with no code or install instructions. It's unclear where those tools come from (built-in platform tools vs. missing implementation).
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are narrowly scoped to discovery, sending, receiving, and peer approval. They do direct the agent to poll udp_receive during long tasks and to auto-deliver messages from approved peers, which could lead to unintended data exchange if approvals are granted incorrectly. The SKILL.md does instruct the agent not to share sensitive project information unless explicitly told — that mitigates but does not remove risk.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec (instruction-only), so nothing will be downloaded or written by the skill itself. This is low-risk in terms of installation, but also explains why the SKILL.md must be relying on pre-existing runtime tools that are not documented here.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill designates UDP_PORT as the primary credential. A port number is not a secret and does not typically need 'credential' status; this is an odd but low-risk choice. No other environment variables or credentials are requested, which is proportionate — except the mismatch between 'required env vars: none' and the declared primaryEnv.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request persistent system-wide changes. Autonomous invocation is allowed (platform default); combined with network messaging this increases blast radius only if peers are approved, but the skill itself does not demand elevated privileges or permanent presence.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to describe a reasonable local UDP messaging capability, but there are a few gaps you should resolve before installing or enabling it: 1) The SKILL.md references udp_discover/udp_send/udp_receive tools and requires 'node' but provides no code or install instructions — confirm whether your agent platform supplies those binaries or ask the skill author for the implementation or an install spec. 2) UDP_PORT is marked as the primary credential even though a port is not secret; check why and make sure no sensitive credentials are expected. 3) The skill instructs the agent to poll for incoming UDP messages and to auto-accept messages from approved peers — be careful granting approvals, and prefer 'always-confirm' trust_mode unless you fully trust the LAN. 4) If you want lower risk, restrict this skill to user-invocable only (avoid autonomous invocation) or require explicit user confirmation before any outgoing message that might include project data. If the author cannot provide code or a clear origin/homepage, treat this skill as incomplete and avoid enabling it until provenance and implementation are confirmed.
